caption: The model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) of different model configurations under varying ratios of activated parameters, specifically comparing a standard Transformer with variants that apply sparsity to either the Attention (ATTN) or Feed-Forward Network (FFN) components, or both. The x-axis represents the "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)" on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 100% to 25%, with tick marks at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis shows "Eval PPL" on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at 11.5, 12.0, 12.5, 13.0, 13.5, and 14.0. Four lines are plotted: the red dashed line labeled "Transformer" remains constant at approximately 11.6 across all ratios. The gray dash-dotted line labeled "Only MoHD FFN" starts at around 11.5 at 100% and increases slightly to about 11.7 at 25%. The dark blue solid line with circular markers labeled "Only MoHD ATTN" begins at 11.5 at 100% and rises steeply to approximately 14.0 at 25%. The blue solid line with cross markers labeled "MoHD ATTN + MLP" starts at 11.5 at 100%, dips slightly to around 11.6 at 75%, then increases to about 13.0 at 25%. The plot demonstrates that sparsity applied to the Attention component leads to a significant increase in Eval PPL as the activated parameter ratio decreases, while sparsity in the FFN component has a much smaller effect.
